item.title: From Pitch to Fortune: The Inspiring Journey of the Richest Footballer
item.description:
Why “Richest Footballer” Means Different Things Depending on What You Measure
The phrase “richest footballer” gets thrown around so casually that it’s almost meaningless unless you define your terms. Over the years, I’ve watched debates twist in circles because people conflate net worth, annual salary, and career earnings. If you’re just starting out, this is the first pitfall to sidestep.
Net worth adds up everything a player owns (cash, homes, investments, businesses) and subtracts debts.
